blocks.text: With 3 KM, 5 KM, and 7 KM distances, the first Xpresso Community Run welcomed first-time and experienced runners on October 24, 2026. Co-organized with District 2 Run Crew, the gathering focused on participation without competitive pressure. The event offered refreshing brews at the finish line.
